name: Dhaka
summary: The capital: a huge, busy city of Mughal and colonial history, river life on the Buriganga, famous street food, museums and shopping.
season_note: Winter (November to February) is the most comfortable. Summer is hot; monsoon brings waterlogging and heavy traffic.
avoid_note: Traffic is heavy: plan short days and use rides or the Metro Rail. Avoid Friday-prayer hours and rush hours for sightseeing.

reach.how: Domestic or international flights to Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport
Intercity trains to Kamalapur and Airport stations
AC coaches to Sayedabad, Gabtoli, Mohakhali

local.note: Uttara to Motijheel is the fastest north-south route.
Short hops only; agree the fare first.

attractions.name: Lalbagh Fort
attractions.what: A 17th-century Mughal fort with a mosque, a tomb and gardens. Calm in the morning.
attractions.tip: Go early; closed on some days.

attractions.name: Ahsan Manzil (Pink Palace)
attractions.what: The riverside palace of the Nawabs, now a museum.
attractions.tip: Closed on some weekdays; check before you go.

attractions.name: Sadarghat river port and Buriganga boat ride
attractions.what: Watch the busiest river port, then ride a small boat across the Buriganga.
attractions.tip: Keep valuables close. Agree the boat fare first.

attractions.name: Star Mosque (Tara Masjid)
attractions.what: A beautiful mosque decorated with star-pattern tiles.

attractions.name: Bangladesh National Museum
attractions.what: The country's biggest museum with art, nature and history galleries.
attractions.tip: Check opening hours; closed one weekday.

attractions.name: Liberation War Museum
attractions.tip: Allow time; some displays are intense.

attractions.name: National Parliament House
attractions.what: A famous modern building by Louis Kahn; the grounds are open at set times.

attractions.name: Old Dhaka food walk (Haji Biryani, Bakarkhani, Nanna)
attractions.what: Eat kacchi biryani, bakarkhani, borhani and fresh sweets.
attractions.tip: Go with a local if you can; eat at busy places.

attractions.name: Dhanmondi Lake and Rabindra Sarobar
attractions.what: A lakeside walk with tea stalls.

attractions.name: National Martyrs' Memorial (Savar)
attractions.what: A national memorial to 1971 with quiet grounds.

rules: Keep valuables close in crowded markets.
Use ride-share or the Metro to avoid long traffic jams.
